body: {"better": "B", "reason": "Card A says 'అందమైన ప్రకృతి దృశ్యాలు' (beautiful nature views) which is not supported by the outing details—the only thing specified is 'Tourist attraction,' not nature views. Card B says 'ప్రశాంతంగా నడవొచ్చు' (can walk peacefully), which is a reasonable inference from a recreation trail and tourist attraction. Card A also uses 'మీరు ఇంటికి' which slightly distances the mother by saying 'you can come home' rather than implying togetherness; Card B's 'ఇంటికి వచ్చేయొచ్చు' is more natural. Both are warm and respectful, but Card A invents unsupported scenery details."}
